newsitem.title: USA: Concord EFS files for 2.0 mln common.
newsitem.headline: Concord EFS files for 2.0 mln common.

text.p: Concord EFS Inc on Wednesday filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 2.0 million common shares.

Net proceeds will be used to augment the capital of its affiliate EFS National Bank, for the acquisition of merchant processing businesses and for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through an underwriting group led by Willliam Blair & Co. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 300,000 additional shares.
